title: The chosen write path: a reorder proposal opens a PR to the solution order
goal: A reorder from the card arrives as an open PR that changes only the list
acceptance: Takes the ordered references and the base the card loaded; rejects an unknown or duplicated reference and a stale base with a message the card can show
Rewrites only the numbered lines between the order markers, keeps each note, and the result passes node tools/solution.mjs check
Opens a PR titled with the moved items, on a new branch, and never merges it; tests on a fake GitHub client for each rejection and for the PR body, committed failing first
The new tool or job is listed in docs/DOMAINS.md and the live index decision page
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: One validated rewrite of a list plus a PR call, on the F-024 service and tools. Estimated 2026-11-26. Not a measurement.
